ingredients.raw: ½ cup yellow corn kernels fresh or frozen, no salt added

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.

recipe_title: Southern-Style Collard Greens with Smoky Mushrooms
short_description: Tune in for the latest research and perspectives on kidney health from NKF.

ingredients.name: 8 cups collard greens, stems removed and chopped
ingredients.raw: 8 cups collard greens, stems removed and chopped

ingredients.name: 4 oz white or oyster mushrooms, sliced
ingredients.raw: 4 oz white or oyster mushrooms, sliced

ingredients.name: ½ tsp crushed red pepper flakes (optional)
ingredients.raw: ½ tsp crushed red pepper flakes (optional)

ingredients.name: ½ cup low-sodium vegetable broth or water, plus more if needed
ingredients.raw: ½ cup low-sodium vegetable broth or water, plus more if needed

instructions: Blanch the collard greens in boiling water for 30 seconds, then rinse with cold water and drain well.
Using a non-stick pan over medium-high heat, dry sauté the mushrooms until golden and crispy, about 6-8 minutes. Season with onion powder, liquid smoke and garlic powder. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add the diced onion and minced garlic with a splash of vegetable broth or water. Cook until onions are translucent, about 4-5 minutes.
Add the collard greens, smoked paprika, onion powder, black pepper, and crushed red pepper flakes. Stir to combine.
Pour in the vegetable broth or water and the liquid smoke. Cover and simmer on low heat for 10-15 minutes until the greens are tender. Add more liquid as needed to prevent drying.
Stir the crispy mushrooms back in. Add lemon juice and adjust seasoning with salt-free spices or a small pinch of salt if desired.

recipe_title: Golden Turnip Latkes with Zesty Red Pepper Relish
short_description: Tune in for the latest research and perspectives on kidney health from NKF.

ingredients.name: 2 flax eggs (2 tablespoons ground flaxseed mixed with 6 tablespoons water, set for 5 minutes)
ingredients.raw: 2 flax eggs (2 tablespoons ground flaxseed mixed with 6 tablespoons water, set for 5 minutes)

instructions: Grate the turnips and onion, then squeeze out as much moisture as possible with a clean towel.
In a large bowl, combine grated turnips, grated onion, flax eggs, flour, coriander, onion powder, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix well to combine.
Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Spoon the mixture onto the baking sheet in small mounds and flatten slightly into latke shapes.
Bake for 15 minutes, then carefully flip each latke and bake an additional 15 minutes until golden and crispy on the edges.
Remove from oven and serve warm.
